name: K-One Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年，K-One 通过全资子公司 K2 Meta 以 RM94,000,000 现金出售其在 G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd 的全部股权给 ITOCHU Singapore 和 ITOCHU Corporation，该交易已于 11 月 6 日完成；同时公司提出资本削减及回退最多 RM75.00 million 以派发特别股息。其他业务板块在公告中未见具体动态。
overview_en: In 2026, K-One, through its wholly-owned subsidiary K2 Meta, disposed of its entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd to ITOCHU Singapore and ITOCHU Corporation for RM94,000,000 in cash, with the disposal completed on 6 November; concurrently, the company proposed a capital reduction and repayment of up to RM75.00 million to facilitate a special dividend. No specific developments were announced for the other business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年主要进行出售 G-AsiaPacific 全部股权及资本回退计划。
segments.note_en: This year mainly involved the disposal of the entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific and a capital reduction and repayment plan.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 出售事项于 2026 年 11 月 6 日（买卖协议成为无条件后的第 15 个营业日）视为完成。
actions.text_en: The disposal was deemed completed on 6 November 2026, being the 15th business day following the date on which the SPA became unconditional.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 买卖协议于 2026 年 10 月 16 日成为无条件。
actions.text_en: The share purchase agreement became unconditional on 16 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司通过法律顾问向高等法院提交申请。
actions.text_en: The company, via its legal counsel, filed an application with the High Court for confirmation and approval of the proposed capital reduction pursuant to Section 116 of the Companies Act 2016.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE:- (I) PROPOSED DISPOSAL BY K2 META SDN BHD, A WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF K-ONE, OF 600,000 AND 4
actions.text_en: Circular to shareholders in relation to the proposed disposal of the entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific and the proposed capital reduction and repayment of up to RM46.00 million.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 以促成向股东派发总额最多 RM75.00 million 的特别股息。
actions.text_en: Proposed capital reduction and repayment to facilitate a special dividend distribution of up to RM75.00 million to shareholders.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: K2 Meta Sdn Bhd（K-One 全资子公司）与 ITOCHU Singapore Pte Ltd 及 ITOCHU Corporation 签订有条件买卖协议，以 RM94,000,000 现金出售 G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd 全部 1,000,000 股普通股。
actions.text_en: K2 Meta Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of K-One, entered into a conditional share purchase agreement with ITOCHU Singapore Pte Ltd and ITOCHU Corporation to dispose of its entire 1,000,000 ordinary shares in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd for RM94,000,000 in cash.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司出售 G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd 全部股权，退出该公司业务。
model_changes.text_en: The company disposed of its entire equity interest in G-AsiaPacific Sdn Bhd, exiting that business.
